ladakh.name: Ladakh
ladakh.subtitle: • High Passes & Glacial Sanctuaries
ladakh.desc: Cobalt glacial lakes at 14,000 ft, white sand cold deserts and ancient Tibetan cliff monasteries.

itineraries.title: Pangong Tso & Nubra Valley High-Pass Expedition
highlights: Day 1: Khardung La Pass (17,982 ft) Crossing
Day 2: Diskit Monastery & Hunder Sand Dunes
Day 3: Pangong Lake Milky Way Glamping
itineraries.tip: Spend your first 36 hours resting completely in Leh to acclimatize smoothly.

himachal.name: Himachal Pradesh
himachal.subtitle: • Valley of the Gods & Spiti Cold Desert
himachal.desc: Centuries-old mud monasteries, turquoise glacial crescent lakes and dramatic mountain passes.

itineraries.title: Spiti Valley Ancient Monasteries & Chandratal Camp
highlights: Day 1: Key Gompa Cliff Monastery blessings
Day 2: Highest post office mail sending at Hikkim
Day 3: Chandratal Moon Lake Stargazing Camp
itineraries.tip: Send a physical postcard from Hikkim (14,567 ft) - it takes 2 weeks to reach anywhere worldwide.

rajasthan.name: Rajasthan
rajasthan.subtitle: • Thar Sands & Royal Rajput Palaces
rajasthan.desc: Golden sandstone ramparts, starlit dune caravans and tranquil mirror-lake royal havelis.

itineraries.title: Jaisalmer Golden Dunes & Thar Desert Caravan
highlights: Day 1: Living Fort Walk & Havelis
Day 2: Sunset Camel Ride in Sam Dunes
Day 3: Manganiyar Folk Night under Stars
itineraries.tip: Request desert camp sites located in the quiet Khuri dunes rather than crowded Sam clusters.

itineraries.title: Udaipur Lake Pichola Royal Haveli
highlights: Day 1: City Palace Museum Private Tour
Day 2: Sunset Solar Boat on Lake Pichola
Day 3: Miniature Painting Masterclass
itineraries.tip: Sunset views from Ambrai Ghat give the purest silhouette of City Palace across water.

uttar_pradesh.name: Uttar Pradesh
uttar_pradesh.subtitle: • Sacred Ganga Ghats & Mughal Legacy
uttar_pradesh.desc: Oldest living spiritual civilization, chanting river ghats, classical sitar notes and marble wonders.

itineraries.title: Varanasi Ghats & Ganga Dawn Aarti Expedition
highlights: Day 1: Twilight Ganga Maha Aarti at Dashashwamedh
Day 2: Dawn Rowboat through Historic Ghats
Day 3: Sarnath Deer Park & Stupa Walk
itineraries.tip: Board your wooden boat at Assi Ghat at 5:15 AM to witness the sun rising directly over the river.

assam.name: Assam
assam.subtitle: • Brahmaputra Valleys & Rhino Corridors
assam.desc: Endangered one-horned rhinoceros reserves, world's largest river island and tea gardens.

itineraries.title: Kaziranga Rhino Sanctuary & Majuli Island River Voyage
highlights: Day 1: Dawn Elephant & Open-top 4x4 Safari
Day 2: Brahmaputra Ferry to Majuli River Island
Day 3: Neo-Vaishnavite Satra Mask Making
itineraries.tip: Western (Bagori) zone of Kaziranga offers the closest sightings of wild rhinos and swamp deer.

maharashtra.name: Maharashtra
maharashtra.subtitle: • Sahyadri Forts & Rock-cut Sanctuaries
maharashtra.desc: Ancient Buddhist monolithic cave carvings, volcanic plateaus and misty Sahyadri passes.

itineraries.title: Ajanta-Ellora Monolithic Caves & Sahyadri Monsoon Trail
highlights: Day 1: Kailasa Temple Rock Monolith Exploration
Day 2: Ajanta Frescoes & Horseshoe Canyon
Day 3: Daulatabad Hill Fortress Ascent
itineraries.tip: Kailasa Temple at Ellora Cave 16 looks most surreal during late afternoon amber hour.

andhra_pradesh.name: Andhra Pradesh
andhra_pradesh.subtitle: • Bay of Bengal Coasts & Eastern Ghats
andhra_pradesh.desc: Emerald tribal coffee canyons, million-year limestone caverns and scenic hill train tracks.

itineraries.title: Araku Valley Tribal Coffee & Borra Caves Odyssey
highlights: Day 1: Vistadome Glass Hill Railway ride
Day 2: Speleology Walk in Borra Caves
Day 3: Organic Tribal Araku Roast Cupping
itineraries.tip: Book the window seat on the morning Vistadome train departing Visakhapatnam for mountain tunnels.

karnataka.name: Karnataka
karnataka.subtitle: • Vijayanagara Empire & Western Ghats
karnataka.desc: UNESCO monolith ruins along boulder-strewn rivers and rain-washed Arabica plantations.

itineraries.title: Hampi Stone Chariot & Tungabhadra Boulders
highlights: Day 1: Vittala Complex & Musical Pillars
Day 2: Sunset Bouldering at Matanga Hill
Day 3: Coracle Boat River Run
itineraries.tip: Climb Matanga Hill by 5:30 AM for a 360-degree panorama of ancient Hampi at sunrise.

itineraries.title: Coorg Coffee Mist Plantation Stay
highlights: Day 1: Arabica Berry Picking Experience
Day 2: Brahmagiri Wildlife Sanctuary Hike
Day 3: Kodava Cupping & Roasting Masterclass
itineraries.tip: November brings fragrant white coffee blossoms across the estate hills.

kerala.name: Kerala
kerala.subtitle: • God's Own Country
kerala.desc: Lush backwaters, Alleppey houseboats, spice estate hillocks & misted tea valleys.

itineraries.title: Munnar Tea Valleys & Western Ghats Trail
highlights: Day 1: Colonial Tea Estate Trek
Day 2: Lockhart Gap Sunrise & Anamudi
Day 3: Organic Spice Farm Harvest
itineraries.tip: Early 6 AM departure to Lockhart Peak avoids cloud cover for the valley view.

itineraries.title: Alleppey Backwaters Houseboat Odyssey
highlights: Day 1: Kettuvallam Private Boarding
Day 2: Vembanad Lake Sunset Cruise
Day 3: Coir Crafting & Kayaking
itineraries.tip: Opt for the narrower inland canals between Champakulam and Kainakary for zero motorboat traffic.

tamil_nadu.name: Tamil Nadu
tamil_nadu.subtitle: • Dravidian Grandeur & Nilgiri Heights
tamil_nadu.desc: Centuries-old stone temples, carved Chettinad mansions and heritage spice banquets.

itineraries.title: Madurai Heritage & Chettinad Mansions Circuit
highlights: Day 1: Meenakshi Amman Temple Dawn Walk
Day 2: Athangudi Tile Workshop & Palaces
Day 3: 7-Course Chettinad Culinary Feast
itineraries.tip: Witness the sacred night ceremony at Meenakshi temple at 9:00 PM for deep spiritual immersion.
